info.cls_ename: Department of Industrial Engineering and Systems Management

description.describe_ch: 本課程強調與說明機率模式與統計方法在工業工程的各種應用。為達成這個目標，本課程教授下列內容：敘述統計、基本機率、抽樣分配、估計問題、假設檢定、迴歸與相關、變異數分析與無母數統計學等。
description.describe_eh: This course emphasizes and illustrates the use of probabilistic models and statistical methodology that is employed in countless applications in industrial engineering. To attain this goal, this course includes the following topics: descriptive statistics, basic probability, probability distributions, sampling distributions, estimation problems, tests of hypotheses, regression and correlation, analysis of variance, nonparametric statistics and so on.

targets.describe_ch: 能用自己的詞彙定義機率模式，而且知道如何運用於工業工程。
targets.describe_en: Be able to describe probabilistic models with their own words, and to know how to use it in industrial engineering.

targets.describe_ch: 瞭解與分析統計原理模式及瞭解統計在工業工程的應用。
targets.describe_en: Understanding and analysis of statistical models and understanding of the principles of statistics in the application of industrial engineering.

targets.describe_ch: 能辨識應用機率模式的場合，並能有效的溝通與清楚表達。
targets.describe_en: Distinguish and make clear statement where probabilistic models can be applied and be able to effective communication.

targets.describe_ch: 能使用機率模式與套裝程式，完成數據分析，並歸納出適當結論。
targets.describe_en: Be able to use probabilistic models  and computer package to finish a data analysis and draw appropriate conclusions.
